title: Average edge error
statement: Let $G$ be a regular unique game with alphabet size $q$, and let a labeling assign one alphabet symbol to each vertex. Its edge error is the average, over a uniformly chosen vertex of $G$, of the local edge error of the labeling at that vertex.
hypotheses_covered: A regular unique game $G$ with alphabet size $q$
